```{python}
#| label: fig-sim-hb-truncation
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Harmonic content of a mildly nonlinear and of a hard-switching waveform, both modeled as $\\tanh(a \\sin \\omega_0 t)$ (left: $a = 0.8$ and $a = 30$). The harmonics of the mildly nonlinear waveform fall off very quickly, so a few harmonics describe it well. Those of the switching waveform decay only roughly as $1/k$ (right, one-sided amplitudes $2|X_k|$), and a harmonic-balance spectrum truncated at $K$ harmonics shows Gibbs ringing at the edges (center)."

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---------- waveforms ----------
N = 4096                                   # time samples per period
t = np.arange(N) / N                       # one period, normalized time t/T0
x_mild = np.tanh(0.8 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * t))
x_hard = np.tanh(30.0 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * t))

def harmonics(x):
    """One-sided harmonic amplitudes |X_k|, k = 0 ... N/2."""
    X = np.fft.rfft(x) / len(x)
    A = 2 * np.abs(X)
    A[0] /= 2
    return A

def truncate(x, K):
    """Fourier series of x truncated after harmonic K."""
    X = np.fft.rfft(x)
    X[K + 1:] = 0
    return np.fft.irfft(X, n=len(x))

A_mild = harmonics(x_mild)
A_hard = harmonics(x_hard)

# ---------- plot ----------
fig, (ax1, ax2, ax3) = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(10, 3.4),
                                    gridspec_kw={'width_ratios': [1, 1, 1.2]})

ax1.plot(t, x_mild, 'g-', linewidth=2, label=r'mild ($a = 0.8$)')
ax1.plot(t, x_hard, 'b-', linewidth=2, label=r'switching ($a = 30$)')
ax1.set_title('Waveforms', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_xlabel(r'Time $t / T_0$')
ax1.set_xlim(0, 1)
ax1.set_ylim(-1.35, 1.35)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax1.legend(loc='lower left', fontsize=8)

ax2.plot(t, x_hard, 'k-', linewidth=1, alpha=0.4, label='exact')
for K, c in ((3, 'tab:orange'), (9, 'tab:red'), (31, 'tab:purple')):
    ax2.plot(t, truncate(x_hard, K), color=c, linewidth=1.3, label=f'$K = {K}$')
ax2.set_title('Switching waveform, truncated', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_xlabel(r'Time $t / T_0$')
ax2.set_xlim(0, 1)
ax2.set_ylim(-1.35, 1.35)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax2.legend(loc='center left', fontsize=8, ncol=2)

k = np.arange(1, 64, 2)                    # odd harmonics (even ones vanish)
ax3.semilogy(k, A_mild[k], 'go', markersize=4, label=r'mild ($a = 0.8$)')
ax3.semilogy(k, A_hard[k], 'bs', markersize=4, label=r'switching ($a = 30$)')
ax3.semilogy(k, 4 / (np.pi * k), 'k--', linewidth=1, label=r'square wave, $4 / (\pi k)$')
ax3.set_title('Harmonic amplitudes', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_xlabel('Harmonic number $k$')
ax3.set_ylabel(r'One-sided amplitude $2|X_k|$')
ax3.set_xlim(0, 64)
ax3.set_ylim(1e-8, 2)
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, which='both')
ax3.legend(loc='lower left', fontsize=8)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
